name: paulian-sync-relay
description: Paulian Calendar sync relay for Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects (free plan). Deploy your own: end-to-end encrypted, optional access key.

scripts.test:unit: vitest run test/core.test.ts test/core2.test.ts test/hardening.test.ts test/pair_auth.test.ts

RETENTION_DAYS_V2.description: Days without any sync activity after which a group's encrypted data is deleted from **your** relay. Default `90`.

RELAY_ACCESS_SECRET.description: Optional access key only your Paulian Calendar apps send. Paste the key the app showed you. If you leave it empty on an older server, the server keeps working without a key.
